def plan_order(tasks: dict[str, tuple[int, list[str], int]], workers: int) -> list[str] | None:

    # Cycle detection using DFS

    color = {name: WHITE for name in tasks}

        color[node] = BLACK

    for name in tasks:
        if color[name] == WHITE:
            if dfs(name):
                return None
    
    # Now simulate
    # Build reverse deps: for each task, which tasks depend on it
    dependents = {name: [] for name in tasks}
    for name, (dur, deps, pri) in tasks.items():
        for dep in deps:
            dependents[dep].append(name)
    
    completed = set()
    running = []  # list of (end_time, task_name)
    ready = set(tasks.keys())  # initially all tasks with no deps? No, all tasks whose deps are all completed

    result = []

                completed.add(tname)
                # Add dependents to ready if all their deps are completed

        running = still_running
        
        # Start tasks

            # Pick best task

        # Advance time to next event
        time = min(end_time for end_time, _ in running)
    
    return result
